name: FX_Hearth

textures.channels: RGB straight colour (sRGB) + alpha = opacity (flames nearly opaque where the fire is thick, smoke up to 0.55); 8 x 8 frames of 256 px, row by row from the top left

source_note: made from the frames of Fire_Wall (same simulation and render): the window [96, 416, 190, 510] of its 512 px frame, the flames lowered towards the sides, scaled to 256 px; colour, opacity, the little smoke and the sparks by tools/fire_encode.py. Needs the frame cache of Fire_Wall (--cache); stage atlas only.
build: blender -b --factory-startup -t 4 --python FableF/tools/build_fire_fx.py -- Hearth --cache <cache of Fire_Wall> --stage atlas
dresses: the fire in the hearth: a compact fire 1.2 m wide and up to 1.4 m tall, tallest in the middle, with a few sparks
known_weaknesses: A flipbook on a card in the fire back, not a volume. The same motion as the wall of flame of the burning house (its middle part). Unlit; the hearth light is the indoor light set, not this card. One loop of 3.2 s.
